text:
maria (product): Heads-up — we need to lock the API header contract for routing before SDK v0.9.0 cut.
aj (eng): Agreed. current proposal: `X-Region-Hint`, `X-Tier-Override`, and `X-Routing-Debug` as an opt-in dev header.
lee (eng-platform): Prefer `X-Redwood-Region` to avoid collisions with cloud vendor headers.
sam (devex): +1 on namespace. We should also document allowed values and a fallback behavior table.
maria (product): Good call. Also: what happens if `X-Tier-Override` requests higher tier than customer's entitlement? Deny or fallback?
aj (eng): Deny by default — we can't silently bill for upgrades. But we could allow a `force=true` debug flag for internal testing.
lee (eng-platform): Implementation detail: routing pipeline will check header -> customer policy -> capacity -> model variant fallback. If requested tier not allowed, return 403 with explain code `tier_not_entitled`.
sam (devex): For developers, 403 needs a clear message: "requested tier not available for your org; contact sales or remove X-Tier-Override".
maria (product): For non-entitled but compatible lower-tier model, should we automatically route down? That could be surprising. I'd rather explicit fallback behavior controlled by `X-Allow-Variant-Fallback: true` header.
aj (eng): Agree — two bits: entitlement failure (403) vs variant fallback (200 + info header `X-Routed-Variant`).
lee (eng-platform): Example header contract proposal:
```
X-Redwood-Region: us-west-2 | eu-central-1 | auto
X-Redwood-Tier: hosted | dedicated | private
X-Redwood-Tier-Override: hosted:premium | dedicated:reserved
X-Redwood-Allow-Variant-Fallback: true | false
X-Redwood-Routing-Debug: request-id,trace
```
maria (product): Nice. Telemetry: each request should attach tags for billing and capacity metrics: region_hint, tier_hint, override_used (bool), fallback_used (bool).
aj (eng): We'll emit those via the tracing span with attributes `rr.region_hint`, `rr.tier_hint`, `rr.override_used`, `rr.fallback_variant`. That way console dashboards can aggregate.
sam (devex): SDK ergonomics: provide two ways — high-level api (region='eu') and low-level headers map. Also a `routingDebug` flag that sets `X-Redwood-Routing-Debug: full` for internal dev only.
lee (eng-platform): Security: `X-Redwood-Tier-Override` must be accepted only for service tokens flagged `can_override_tier`. Normal API keys ignore it.
maria (product): UX on console: when a rollout changes fallback chains, surface a routing matrix per model showing variant priorities and whether fallback will be attempted.
aj (eng): Edge case: cross-region fallback — if region_hint=eu and eu capacity exhausted, should we try `region=auto` fallback to us? Cross-region has compliance implications.
sam (devex): Default policy: do not cross regions unless `X-Redwood-Region: auto` or `X-Redwood-Allow-Cross-Region: true`. We need very visible warnings in console/outbound logs.
lee (eng-platform): Quotas: header hints should not bypass tenant quotas. If override pushes to a dedicated pool, we must check committed capacity first. If over-commit, respond with 429 and `retry-after`.
maria (product): Error codes proposal: 403 `tier_not_entitled`, 429 `capacity_exceeded`, 200 + `X-Routed-Variant` when fallback used. Also include `X-Routing-Decision-Id` to link traces.
aj (eng): Implementation note: include decision id in logs/traces and expose in console timeline for debugging rollouts.
sam (devex): Doc snippet for SDK:
```
// high level
client.generate({prompt, routing:{region:'eu-central-1', tier:'hosted', allowVariantFallback:true}})
// low level
client.headers({'X-Redwood-Region':'eu-central-1','X-Redwood-Allow-Variant-Fallback':'true'})
```
lee (eng-platform): infra-bot: can you trigger a canary deploy for header-parsing changes on staging?
infra-bot: deploy started for branch `routing-header-contract` — canary to staging-1 (10% traffic).
maria (product): Last mile: will Analytics/console show `override_used` and `fallback_used` per request so PMs can evaluate impact?
aj (eng): Yes — we will add those metrics (counter + p95 latency) to per-route dashboards.
sam (devex): Also add an audit log entry when `X-Redwood-Tier-Override` is accepted for an org (who used it, when). Useful for security and billing reconciliation.
lee (eng-platform): Action items: 1) Finalize header names & allowed values (owners: aj + lee) 2) Spec telemetry keys (owner: aj) 3) SDK mapping + examples (owner: sam) 4) Console matrix UI for fallbacks (owner: maria) 5) Canary deploy (owner: infra-bot).
maria (product): Thanks — I'll create the PR for the product spec and add the edge cases (cross-region compliance) to the backlog.
aj (eng): I'll draft the runtime checks and error codes.
sam (devex): I'll prepare SDK examples and a short doc for the changelog.
lee (eng-platform): Leaving a note: make sure tests cover combinations: region+tier override+no-entitlement+allow-fallback=false.
maria (product): OK everyone — let's sync tomorrow if needed. :thumbsup:
